digest.component_or_area: Plan-review T10 overlay-infra rubric and evaluation specification
propositions: The T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments via an explicit scope clause while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secret, untrusted-network endpoint authentication).

The rubric scope clause must be followed immediately by a co-located four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier that preserves destructive, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and endpoint-auth protections for transient infrastructure despite the transient-lifecycle exemption.

A packaged eval spec with ten live dataset cases (five pass, five finding) must calibrate T10 behavior on transient loopback probes, durable lifecycle safety, destructive transient applies, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secrets, and untrusted-network transient services.

The T10 rubric must remain independent: it must not name T15 or assign scope to another overlay, and must pass offline text-contract tests asserting exact scope/qualifier wording and absence of cross-criterion delegation.

The NEW_SPECS registry entry and strict packaged-spec validation (schema validity, scorer discipline, dataset balance, gold-set coverage) must extend to plan-review-T10 so all plan-review criteria undergo unified compliance testing.

The regenerated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must render the durable-infrastructure scope clause and four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier, and rebar explain T10 must display both clauses with no cross-criterion references.
